findings.rule: A list of up to five keywords should be provided below the abstract.
A short statement of less than 100 words about the significance of the paper should be added.
findings.problem: The significance statement contains roughly 130 words, exceeding the 100‑word limit.

findings.rule: At the header on each odd page from page 3, a Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required.
findings.problem: The running title "Coarse-grained elastic network analysis of allosteric coupling in ring ATPases" is about 72 characters long.

findings.rule: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required and must not include references.
References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text.
findings.problem: The reference list is out of order (e.g., [5] is followed by [7] then [6]).

findings.rule: The use of “in preparation” and “submitted for publication” is not allowed in the Reference list.
Personal communications should appear parenthetically in the text, not in the reference list.
findings.problem: Reference [8] is a personal communication included in the reference list.

findings.rule: When a DOI is available it should be added as a URL (e.g., https://doi.org/...).
findings.problem: Reference [4] provides a DOI in the form “doi:10.1016/...”, not as a URL.

findings.rule: Figures must be at a resolution of 300 dpi for printing.
findings.problem: Fig1_modes.bmp and Fig2_spectra.bmp are only 150 dpi.

findings.rule: Do not include spaces or Japanese characters (multi-byte codes) in file names; use only alphanumeric characters.
findings.problem: File "図1_final version.tiff" contains Japanese characters and spaces.

findings.rule: The size of each uploaded file must be no more than 20 MB.
findings.problem: Suppl_Movie_1.mov is 45 MB, exceeding the 20 MB limit.

findings.rule: All authors must declare conflicts of interest (or lack thereof).
findings.problem: The statement lists conflicts for K.M., A.T., and R.N. only; H.K. and S.J.W. are omitted.

findings.rule: A Data availability statement must be included before the References.
findings.problem: The manuscript does not contain any Data availability statement.

findings.rule: For experiments involving animal material, a statement identifying the institutional/licensing committee approving the experiments must be included in the Methods section.
findings.problem: The manuscript reports use of rabbit skeletal‑muscle myosin but provides no ethics approval statement.

findings.rule: Text footnotes are not allowed from page 2 onwards.
